leadText:
Christopher (Japanese: ツリオ Tsurio) is a character of the day who appeared in Dueling Heroes.

He was the first of 's two opponents in the quarterfinal rounds of the Whirl Cup. He appeared to be an experienced Pokémon Trainer, as he had attached his Lure Ball to a fishing rod and released his by casting the line.

Despite his efforts, Christopher failed to emerge victorious against Ash and his . Using , Totodile blocked Kingdra from using a attack. This caused the water to build up inside its body and it got sent flying once Totodile let it go. Ash proceeded to move on to his with , while Christopher was eliminated from the competition.
